plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Bob Jahn was a plasma physicist, a scientist who studies superheated electrically charged gas, and worked at the aircraft company Boeing. According to Michels, Jahn went on to run the PEAR lab at Princeton University, a lab that studied the paranormal. He tells it to show that a serious mainstream scientist took these questions on.
